name: esptool-git-frontend
description: esptool-js is consumed from its git reference and compiled from its TypeScript: it publishes no built output, so there is nothing to vendor prebuilt. Naming it under web_modules.sourceDependencies fetches it, compiles it into web_modules/esptool-js/ under the layout its own tsconfig declares, and resolves it like any other vendored package — one bare specifier, no mount. pako and atob-lite are ordinary registry deps, vendored prebuilt; esptool-js imports both.
